"""Independent expanded eligibility replay; ignored review harness only."""
import argparse,hashlib,importlib.util,itertools,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from unicorn import UC_HOOK_CODE
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--repository',type=Path,default=HERE.parents[3])
parser.add_argument('--original-elf',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--compiled-report',type=Path,default=HERE/'final/validation.json')
parser.add_argument('--executable',type=Path,default=HERE/'final/host.exe')
parser.add_argument('--report',type=Path,default=HERE/'final/additional-branches.json')
args=parser.parse_args()
ROOT=args.repository.resolve();MODULE=ROOT/'port/level-world'
original=args.original_elf.resolve();exe=args.executable.resolve()
baseline=json.loads(args.compiled_report.read_text())
def confirm_hashes():
 for rel,wanted in baseline['source_sha256'].items():
  assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==wanted,('source changed since compile',rel)
confirm_hashes()
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'port/engine-resources/tests'))
import cpu
BaseCpu=cpu.Cpu
observed=set()
class CoverageCpu(BaseCpu):
 def __init__(self,*args,**kwargs):
  super().__init__(*args,**kwargs)
  self.uc.hook_add(UC_HOOK_CODE,lambda uc,at,size,unused: observed.add(at) if 0x3a52a4<=at<0x3a53d8 else None)
cpu.Cpu=CoverageCpu
path=MODULE/'tests/run_character_update_eligibility_host.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('independent_eligibility',path)
review=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(review)
rows=list(review.fixtures())
def add(name,**values):
 x=dict(online=0,remote=0,local=0x7002,cull=1,dead=0,respawn=0,visual=1,node_cull=1,visibility_80=0,field_2fc=0,gate_1480=0,node_flag=9,mutations=0)
 x.update(values);rows.append((name,x))
for n,(online,remote,dead,respawn,visual) in enumerate(itertools.product((0,1,128,255),(0,17,0xffffffff),(0,17,0xffffffff),(0,17,0xffffffff),(0,1))):
 add(f'independent_truth_{n}',online=online,remote=remote,dead=dead,respawn=respawn,visual=visual)
for n,(remote,cull,visibility,local,mutations) in enumerate(itertools.product((0,17),(0,1),(0,1),(0x7001,0x7002),(1,2,4,8,16,31))):
 add(f'independent_mutation_{n}',online=1,remote=remote,cull=cull,visibility_80=visibility,local=local,mutations=mutations)
add('independent_zero_node_and_byte',node_cull=0,field_2fc=0)
add('independent_zero_node_nonzero_byte',node_cull=0,field_2fc=7)
for n,(visibility,gate,field) in enumerate(itertools.product((128,255),(128,255),(128,255))):
 add(f'independent_raw_visibility_bytes_{n}',visibility_80=visibility,gate_1480=gate,field_2fc=field,node_cull=0,cull=0,dead=0xffffffff)
review.fixtures=lambda:rows
records=review.oracle(original,exe)
assert observed==set(range(0x3a52a4,0x3a53d8,4)),[hex(x) for x in set(range(0x3a52a4,0x3a53d8,4))-observed]
for record in records:
 original_value=record['original_result'];host=record['host'];ops=[c[0] for c in record['original_calls']]
 expected=1 if original_value else (3 if 5 in ops else 2)
 assert host['outcome']==expected,(record['name'],expected,host)
confirm_hashes()
report=dict(validation='PASS',original_arm_cases=len(records),active_instructions_observed=len(observed),original_instruction_addresses=[hex(x) for x in sorted(observed)],mismatches=0,original_elf_sha256=review.SHA,source_sha256=baseline['source_sha256'],executable_sha256=hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),review_harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),scope='Exact final compiled eligibility kernel. Engine callees are modeled typed fixtures; all77 original caller instructions observed, no callee-body credit and no native activation claim.',cases=records)
args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:report[k] for k in ('validation','original_arm_cases','active_instructions_observed','mismatches','executable_sha256')}))
